name: bizplug-vacation-rentals
description: The vacation rentals plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: home availability, nightly rates and booking. It works from the business's own published profile, covering homes and who they sleep, nightly rates, house rules, check-in and the local area, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Home availability, nightly rates and booking for vacation rentals businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Home availability, nightly rates and booking
test_cases.expect: Calls check_rental_availability and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Do you have a house on Seabrook Island for 4 people next weekend?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_booking only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
